title: Extra Installments for Households with Enrolled Students — Inactive School Nutrition Services Meal Account Repayment
content:
The repayment plan for an inactive account sets more installments for a household that still has students in the district, counting the household's enrollment records in status enrolled in the district's Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions records: two more (2) when there are three or more, one more (1) when there are two, and no change otherwise. This applies to the installments of a repayment payment on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account.

| Household's enrollment records in status enrolled | Change to the installments |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | two more |
| 2 | one more |
| 1 or none | no change |

Records in any other status (for example withdrawn or completed) are not counted.

**Hypothetical.** A household with one child enrolled at an elementary school and one at a high school has two records in status enrolled: one more installment. When a third child's record is enrolled, two more.
